evidence_issue: Two-year catches and detected stream refugia
observation: Hamr reports 1 fish at Pebbly Creek in 1988; 1 at Swampy Creek, 3 at Bonnet Bay Creek 1 and 6 at Creek 2 in 1989; no further Pebbly fish in 1989. Chilcott summarises 11 recorded fish and no lake records.
spatial_scope: Four named streams across the two years; impoundment surveyed
effort: Comprehensive electrofishing; quantitative effort and catchability not established
defensible_constraint: Low observed catches and a transition to detected tributary refugia
unsupported_inference: 11 as instantaneous abundance; four streams occupied simultaneously; lake nondetection as a perfect census
unresolved_information: Original survey effort, areas covered and detection probabilities

evidence_issue: Cumulative detection footprint versus later distribution survey
observation: Sanger summarises five positive sites of 117 over 1988-1991. Hamr dates the 117-location distribution survey to February 1990-May 1991; Chilcott also dates 117 sites to 1990-1991. Hamr reports continuing Bonnet Bay populations and one Stillwater fish, with no further Pebbly or Swampy detections.
dates: Cumulative positive streams: 1988-1991; distribution survey: February 1990-May 1991
spatial_scope: Lake Pedder-Serpentine drainage and some Lake Gordon drainage; five historically positive streams
effort: Permanent watercourses visited at least once, some repeatedly; Stillwater had five unsuccessful revisits after its single positive record
defensible_constraint: Severe contraction; distinguish historically detected streams from sites detected during the later survey
unsupported_inference: Five simultaneous occupied sites in 1990-1991; 5/117 as a common-time occupancy estimate; mechanically replacing five with three without the original site table
unresolved_information: Hamr Table 1 and Appendix 1 numeric/site cells are degraded in local transcription; exact survey-site identities and relation to cumulative denominator require the original tables

evidence_issue: Repeated Bonnet Bay catches versus unique fish or abundance
observation: Sanger reports 68 specimens captured in 43 trips. Hamr confirms 21 visits to Creek 1 and 22 to Creek 2, with fish normally returned except captive-breeding retention.
spatial_scope: Two Bonnet Bay creeks, principally lower meandering reaches
effort: Repeated stream-specific electrofishing; catch-return sampling and some removals
defensible_constraint: 68 reported capture events across 43 visits at the two specified creeks
unsupported_inference: 68 demonstrated distinct individuals; a census abundance; 43 equal-effort samples of the entire 117-site footprint
unresolved_information: Recapture identities, per-visit dates/catches/effort, sampled reaches and removal history; Hamr Table 2 numeric cells are degraded in local transcription

evidence_issue: Multi-year collection total versus natural population size
observation: Chilcott reports ten individuals collected during extensive 1992-1996 surveys. The recovery plan locates ten recorded individuals in Bonnet Bay streams without specifying that interval in its passage. Hamr records one fish caught on 4 February 1992 and subsequently transferred to Lake Oberon.
dates: 1992-1996 in Chilcott; 4 February 1992 individual record in Hamr
spatial_scope: Natural Lake Pedder system in Chilcott; Bonnet Bay streams in recovery plan
effort: Extensive surveys; one documented 1992 visit used two electrofishing teams
defensible_constraint: Sparse later collections, including at least one documented removal
unsupported_inference: Ten as total natural population abundance; known distinct-individual status of all ten; uniform effort across years
unresolved_information: Per-visit records, unique identities and destinations of collected fish

observation: The 2005 assessment reports five specimens collected during surveys in 1994-1997, with the last collection in 1996; Chilcott reports ten collected in 1992-1996.
effort: IFS surveys; visit-level effort not provided
defensible_constraint: Retain both source-specific descriptions as potentially compatible summaries of differing intervals
unsupported_inference: An established contradiction; independent datasets that can be added or treated as independent evidence
unresolved_information: Original logs needed to reconcile the overlapping counts

evidence_issue: Retrospective fewer-than-50 estimate and ambiguous population scope
observation: The 2023 listing statement retrospectively reports an estimated population below 50 when the species entered the original schedules of the Tasmanian 1995 Act. The passage gives no estimation method and does not explicitly restrict the estimate to natural populations.
dates: Circa initial 1995 listing; retrospective statement published 2023
spatial_scope: Population scope not explicitly restricted to natural habitat in the cited passage
defensible_constraint: Rough contextual estimate around initial listing, with uncertain derivation and scope
unsupported_inference: A natural-range abundance estimate throughout 1992-1996; a hard upper bound; a lower-bound anchor as labelled in E037 model_use
unresolved_information: Original listing assessment, estimate derivation, exact reference date and inclusion or exclusion of captive/translocated fish

observation: The recovery plan identifies 6 March 1996 as the final sighting or collection; Chilcott repeats the collection date.
spatial_scope: Natural Lake Pedder system; final refuge history in tributaries
effort: Dated detection followed by further surveys
defensible_constraint: Presence on that date and the last event in the known detection sequence
unsupported_inference: Extinction during 1996; exact last year of latent population presence
unresolved_information: Final capture record, within-year event timing relative to model state, and subsequent detection effort

evidence_issue: Subsequent nondetection and unquantified annual effort
observation: The recovery plan reports no subsequent sightings or collections despite intensive annual electrofishing in good low-flow conditions through 2002. The 2005 assessment explicitly describes unsuccessful extensive surveys in 1998-2002 and cites unpublished IFS field logbooks for that period.
dates: After 6 March 1996 through 2002; explicitly documented assessment block 1998-2002
effort: Intensive annual electrofishing, described qualitatively; visit-level effort unavailable
defensible_constraint: Persistent nondetection under substantial search effort, supporting eventual natural-range loss
unsupported_inference: Zero latent abundance every surveyed year; numerically identified or constant detection probability; assuming 1997 was unsurveyed because the assessment emphasises 1998-2002
